name: seld/jsonlint
input_api: Seld\JsonLint\JsonParser::parse(string $input, int $flags = 0) over local bytes; default flags decode objects to stdClass
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text decoded into PHP stdClass/array/scalar values with default flags
family: seld/jsonlint Lexer and LR table parser
family_note: Own pure-PHP Lexer.php and JsonParser.php LR parse table; the pinned source contains no json_decode call. String escapes are expanded by its own preg_replace_callback interpolation. Composer depends on it, which inflates its download count; Composer itself calls json_decode first and uses JsonParser to report errors.
not_verified: Only default flags on one valid UTF-8 object control were run. ALLOW_COMMENTS, duplicate-key flags, PARSE_TO_ASSOC, VALIDATE_UTF8_ENCODING, byte-order-mark input (rejected by failOnBOM), large integers, depth limits and malformed input are unverified.

name: laminas/laminas-json
input_api: Set Laminas\Json\Json::$useBuiltinEncoderDecoder = true, then Json::decode(string $input) over local JSON text; forces package Decoder instead of ext/json
scope: JSON text decoded by Laminas own PHP Decoder when static flag forces the internal implementation
family: Laminas Json Decoder pure-PHP parser (Zend JSON lineage)
family_note: The default Json::decode route delegates to PHP ext/json. The documented useBuiltinEncoderDecoder flag is set true before each call so the own Decoder.php parse path runs; Xdebug source coverage requires Decoder.php. Package is abandoned as documented by its maintainers; cumulative downloads reflect historical adoption. Zendframework/zend-json shares the predecessor lineage and is not counted as an independent family.
not_verified: Two valid nested object/array controls were run with exact structural summaries. Expression extensions, duplicate keys, large inputs, scalar roots and malformed input remain unverified.

name: halaxa/json-machine
input_api: JsonMachine\Items::fromString(string $input, array $options) over local JSON text; iteration yields top-level members; ExtJsonDecoder decodes each value
scope: JSON object or array roots; JSON Machine incrementally parses top-level members and PHP ext/json decodes each yielded member value
family: JSON Machine Lexer/Parser plus PHP ext/json member decoder
family_note: The package has its own streaming Lexer and Parser, but default ExtJsonDecoder delegates each value to json_decode. This composite family shares ext/json with the runtime path; the harness invokes Items::fromString directly and iterates every top-level member.
not_verified: Two valid nested object/array controls were run with exact structural summaries. Scalar roots, JSON Pointer paths, custom decoders, large streaming inputs, duplicate keys and malformed input remain unverified.

name: salsify/json-streaming-parser
input_api: new JsonStreamingParser\Parser(resource $stream, ListenerInterface $listener) then parse() over a php://memory stream holding local JSON text; harness listener builds stdClass/list values from startObject/startArray/key/value events
scope: One JSON object or array root read from a stream by salsify's own pure-PHP character state machine; scalars converted by ParserHelper without ext/json
family: salsify JsonStreamingParser character state machine (SAX-style listener)
family_note: Parser.php consumes the stream byte by byte and emits listener events; numbers use filter_var and casts, strings and \u escapes are decoded in package code, and no json_decode call exists in the package source. The harness supplies its own tree-building listener because the bundled InMemoryListener maps objects to PHP arrays, losing the object/array distinction. Distinct from seld/jsonlint, Laminas Decoder, JSON Machine and ext/json.
not_verified: Two valid nested object/array controls were run with exact structural summaries. Scalar roots (rejected by the parser), concatenated documents (rejected by the harness), byte-order marks, custom line endings and buffer sizes, the bundled listeners, large streaming inputs, duplicate keys and malformed input remain unverified.

name: pcrov/jsonreader
input_api: new pcrov\JsonReader\JsonReader() then json(string $json) over local bytes, pulled with read()/type()/name()/value()/depth(); harness builds a type-tagged tree from OBJECT/ARRAY/scalar nodes. open(string $uri) on the local control file and stream(resource) are cross-checked for the same tree
scope: One complete UTF-8 JSON text from local bytes passed to documented JsonReader::json(string) and pulled with read()/type()/name()/value()/depth(); harness builds an exact type-tagged tree from OBJECT/ARRAY/scalar nodes. open(local file) and stream(resource) are cross-checked to yield the same tree.
family: pcrov JsonReader Lexer and JsonParser pull state machine
family_note: Lexer.php tokenizes bytes itself (literals, numbers, strings, escapes and \u surrogate pairs via IntlChar); JsonParser.php is a goto state machine that emits (type, name, value, depth) nodes and rejects trailing tokens after the root. JsonReader::value() casts numbers with unary plus. The pinned package source contains no json_decode call; UTF-8 validation is delegated to the pcrov/unicode dependency (outside coverage scope). value() on containers returns objects as PHP arrays, so the harness builds objects and arrays from node types instead. Distinct from seld/jsonlint, Laminas Decoder, JSON Machine, salsify and ext/json.
not_verified: Two valid nested object/array controls were run with exact type-tagged trees through json(); open() on the local control file and stream() on its file handle were cross-checked outside coverage. psr7Stream(), remote URIs, FLOATS_AS_STRINGS, value() tree building on containers, next()/name-targeted skipping, scalar roots, duplicate keys (the harness rejects them), empty or NUL member names, integers beyond PHP_INT_MAX, byte-order marks, non-UTF-8 input, large streaming inputs and malformed input remain unverified. pcrov/unicode UTF-8 validation is outside the coverage and AFL++ scope.

name: boundwize/jsonrecast
input_api: Boundwize\JsonRecast\JsonRecast::parse(string $source) over local bytes returns a JsonDocument AST; harness walks ObjectNode items, ArrayNode items, StringNode/BooleanNode values, NullNode and NumberNode::toIntOrFloat() into a type-tagged tree with members in source order
scope: One complete JSON text from local bytes passed to documented JsonRecast::parse(string); harness walks the returned JsonDocument AST (ObjectNode/ArrayNode/StringNode/NumberNode::toIntOrFloat()/BooleanNode/NullNode) into an exact type-tagged tree with members in source order and duplicate names rejected.
family: boundwize/jsonrecast Lexer and recursive-descent JsonParser (formatting-preserving AST)
family_note: Own Lexer.php tokenizes the whole text (whitespace, punctuation, literals, strings) with NumberLexemeScanner for numbers, and JsonParser.php is a recursive-descent parser that builds an editable AST with offsets, whitespace and indentation metadata (IndentDetector). Each string token's text, quotes included, is decoded by ext/json json_decode for escape expansion; structure, keys order, literals and numbers stay in package code (NumberNode keeps the raw lexeme; toIntOrFloat() casts it). Distinct from seld/jsonlint, Laminas Decoder, JSON Machine, salsify, pcrov and ext/json.
not_verified: Two valid nested object/array controls were run through parse(string) with exact ordered type-tagged trees. Traversal, visitors and formatting-preserving printing, maximum-depth guards, duplicate member names (the harness rejects them), scalar roots, big integers beyond PHP_INT_MAX, -0, byte-order marks, non-UTF-8 input and malformed input remain unverified. String escape decoding is ext/json on single string tokens.

name: laktak/hjson
input_api: new HJSON\HJSONParser() then parse(string $text) with default options over local UTF-8 bytes; returns stdClass objects, PHP lists and scalars that the harness type-tags with members in returned order
scope: One complete JSON text from local UTF-8 bytes passed to documented HJSONParser::parse(string) with default options (objects as stdClass); harness type-tags the returned value with members in returned order. Hjson is a JSON superset; only strict JSON controls are tested.
family: hjson-php HJSONParser (port of hjson-js) recursive character parser
family_note: Own recursive character parser: HJSONParser.php splits text into UTF-8 characters, parses objects, arrays, quoted strings with escapes and \u sequences itself, and reads literals and numbers through HJSONUtils::tryParseNumber (0+$string gives int or float). The only json_decode call converts the result when the assoc option is set, which the harness does not use. Hjson is a superset of JSON (optional root braces, quoteless strings, comments, optional commas), so this path is counted only for parsing valid JSON; the README states parse() accepts JSON or Hjson text. Distinct from the other selected families and from ext/json.
not_verified: Two valid nested object/array controls were run through parse() with default options and gave exact ordered type-tagged trees. Hjson-only syntax acceptance (quoteless strings, comments, optional commas, multiline strings, rootless objects) means invalid RFC 8259 input is not rejected; the empty member name is dropped and duplicate names overwrite, by source reading, not run. keepWsc/parseWsc, assoc, \u surrogate pairs, big integers, scalar roots, byte-order marks and malformed input remain unverified.
